headline: Public hearings on South Willow Street gaming facility and fueling station, plus Manchester Street and Elm Street developments.
summary: The agenda lists subdivision, site plan, and conditional use requests. Several South Willow Street items are continued to August 5, 2026.
items: SP2026-010 (continued from July 2, 2026): site plan for a 73,240 sq. ft. Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces at 1279 South Willow Street and nearby lots; continuance requested to August 5, 2026
CU2026-004 (continued from July 2, 2026): conditional use permit to reduce required parking during construction phasing at the same lots; continuance requested to August 5, 2026
S2026-011 (continued from July 2, 2026): subdivision to adjust lot lines between Lots 6 and 7B at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive; continuance requested to August 5, 2026

SP2026-011 (continued from July 2, 2026): site plan to raze a former fueling station and build a new fueling station with convenience store, drive-through restaurant, and fueling canopy at 1265 South Willow Street; continuance requested to August 5, 2026
CU2026-005 (continued from July 2, 2026): conditional use permit to reduce on-site parking from 19 to 14 spaces at 1265 South Willow Street; continuance requested to August 5, 2026
S2026-012: completeness determination for subdivision of 103 Ray St into Lots 18 and 18A; postponement requested under Section 4.8 of the Subdivision and Site Plan Review Regulations
CU2026-007: conditional use to reduce parking from nine to eight spaces for a 9-dwelling unit building at 285 Manchester Street
SP2026-009: site plan to convert a funeral home at 285 Manchester Street into a 9-dwelling unit building
SP2026-013: site plan to change use from a food processing plant to a landscape contractor's office with outside storage at 231 Woodland Avenue
S2026-013: subdivision of 111 Villa Street (13,555 SF) into Lot 30 (7,284 SF) and Lot 30A (6,271 SF)
S2026-014: subdivision of 30 Dawson Avenue into Lot 2 (8,368 SF) and Lot 2A (7,094 SF)
SP2026-012: redevelopment of the 1308 Elm Street superette into a 6-story mixed-use building with 51 residential units, 3,468 sq. ft. of commercial space, and a 25-vehicle parking garage
Review of new applications for Regional Impact and comment by the Manchester Conservation Commission
location: City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
LIMITED PUBLIC HEARING AND BUSINESS MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, July 16, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
Revised July 14, & July 15, 2026 
 
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Boar d members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. LIMITED PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
1. SP2026-010 – Continued from July 2, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a new site plan application for 
the redevelopment of five lots (formerly three lots) into a single lot of record for a proposed 73,240 
sq. ft. (formerly 63,175 sq. ft.) Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces (formerly 
562) and the associ ated site improvements, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss & O’Neill, Inc. for 
Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
Request for continuance to August 5, 2026 
 
2. CU2026-004 – Continued from July 2, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a conditional use permit is for a 
reduction in required parking due to the phasing of construction. The applicant seeks to keep the 
existing facility until the new facility is granted occupancy, at such time the existing facility is to be 
razed and the remainder of the parking field would be completed, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss 
& O’Neill, Inc. for Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
Request for continuance to August 5, 2026 
 
3. S2026-011 – Continued from July 2, 2026

Lots 6 and 7B) , a subdivision application to adjust the abutting lot lines located between Lots 6 
and 7B, where Lot 7B is to allocate 11,683 SF in area to Lot 6, resulting in a new t otal lot area of 
41,659 SF for Lot 6, in a BC-2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, 
Inc. and Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)  
 Request for continuance to August 5, 2026
